text:
sara: noticed a brief spike in TLS handshake failures + 504s at ~02:14 UTC that correlated with a route promotion. repeating pattern from previous months. creating this follow-up to capture owners and steps.

 tom: saw it too. client retries piled up and hit an older fallback pool which had rotated certs later than the primary. error rate peaked for ~7m.

 rachel: logs show fallback-legacy-02 completed rotation at 2026-01-08T02:12:05Z while primary was at 02:10:40Z. mismatch window ~85s. some SDKs retry aggressively which amplified failures.

 anand: repro in staging by flipping routes then forcing TTL=600 on resolver — old IPs persisted and got routed to fallback. confirmed SNI mismatch errors in TLS handshake.

 sara: proposed actions: 1) cert-rotation ordering guarantee + preflight check (owner: rachel, ETA: 48h) 2) short-term mitigation: lower edge DNS TTL for active rollouts 600->120 (owner: tom, ETA: 24h) 3) LB fallback health gate (owner: anand, ETA: 72h) 4) add cross-region retry alert and dashboard (owner: sara, ETA: 36h) 5) capture recurring pattern in recurring-issues doc + schedule runbook review (owner: sara, ETA: EOW).

 tom: for TTL change i'll run it during a 30m window and coordinate netops. snippet i'll use with nsupdate: 
``` 
server 8.8.8.8
zone redwood.ai
update delete edge.redwood.ai. A
update add edge.redwood.ai. 120 A 1.2.3.4
send
``` 
will schedule tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

 rachel: cert preflight: i'll add a step to rotation job to fetch /_internal/cert-info from each pool and compare serial + notBefore. if mismatch, pause and alert. starting PR.

 anand: LB gating plan: health probe that does a full TLS handshake + validates SNI/cert chain for candidate fallbacks. will integrate into kube-lb readiness checks. building rollback commands too.

 sara: i've opened tracker ISSUE-5199: https://redwood-internal/triage/ISSUE-5199 and added the tasks. tagging owners.

 ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window created for DNS TTL change on 2026-01-09T09:00Z (owner: tom).

 tom: PR for TTL admin script: https://github.com/redwood/netops/pull/102 added. sandbox run successful.

 rachel: cert preflight PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/920 — includes cert-info endpoint and pause-on-diff. staging tests running.

 anand: gating config landed on branch, staging canary scheduled. I'll post playbook rollback steps here once finalized.

 sara: quick acceptance test: simulate route flip and verify SNI failures <0.5% for 30m post-rollout. owners: rachel + anand.

 tom: i'll be on-call for the TTL change and will post updates here.

 rachel: started work on rotation job change, will update PR with test results.

 anand: LB gating tests green in staging canary.

 sara: thanks all. please drop short started/done updates in this thread. we'll monitor retry and tls metrics for 72h after changes.

 ops-bot: Automated: follow-up checklist added to ISSUE-5199 by sara.
